title: Te karanga i roa te wā
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi wairua e tū takitahi ana ki te whawhai ki tētahi ao whānui, e whakatau ana ki te ārahi i a rātou i te hē me te ngākau māia. Mō ngā rautau, i whakakahoretia te karere, i tawaihia, i whakakorekorehia—engari kāore i mutu te mahi. I te mutunga, ka tae mai he whakatau nui, ā, he tokoiti noa iho i eke ki te whakaoranga i te taha o tēnei wairua pumau. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei āhua i roto i te Quran?
clues: I tonoa ahau hei kaiwhakatūpato ki te iwi kua ngaro i ō rātou ake ara.
I karanga ahau i a rātou kia rapu murunga hara, kia tahuri ke hoki i ā rātou mahi hē, engari i tahuri ke atu rātou.
I raro i te whakahau a te Atua, i hanga e au tētahi waka nui i te mea e mātakitaki mai ana, e tawai mai ana hoki tōku iwi ki ahau.
I karanga tonu ahau ki tōku Ariki—i te mutunga ka whakautu mai ia, ā, ka ringihia mai te wai i te rangi me ngā waipuke.
I eke tahi ahau me te hunga i whakapono i te taenga mai o te waipuke ki runga ake i te whenua.
I karanga atu ahau ki tētahi i noho ki muri, me te tono kia rere rātou ki te maunga hei piringa, engari kua paahitia kētia te ture.
